question: Which cycle consists of sedimentary and gaseous cycles?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Biogeochemical cycle**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Biogeochemical cycle** consists of both sedimentary and gaseous cycles.
 
• Biogeochemical cycles involve the movement of elements and compounds among living organisms and the physical environment.
